# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 2 Slot 85: Late 4D Hegemons 0-Override Deepening & Anti-Hegemon Tension Cache (oe_heg2_, 0 vanilla/GUI overrides). Generated by gen_late_hegemons.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Adjust global_var:oe_heg2_tension by $amount$ and clamp to 0..100.
oe_heg2_add_tension = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension add = $amount$ }
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension value = $amount$ }
	}
	clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope: synchronize mil hegemon deepening tier (1..3) and eclipse check.
oe_heg2_sync_mil = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:military_hegemon }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_mil_ticks }
			change_variable = { name = oe_heg2_mil_ticks add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_mil_ticks value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:oe_heg2_mil_ticks >= 40
					AND = {
						var:oe_heg2_mil_ticks >= 16
						oe_heg2_meets_mil_t3 = yes
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_mil_tier value = 3 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier1_mod
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier2_mod
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier3_mod months = 8 mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:oe_heg2_mil_ticks >= 20
					AND = {
						var:oe_heg2_mil_ticks >= 6
						oe_heg2_meets_mil_t2 = yes
					}
					has_advance = oe_heg2_adv_grand_hegemony
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_mil_tier value = 2 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier1_mod
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier3_mod
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier2_mod months = 8 mode = replace }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_mil_tier value = 1 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier2_mod
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier3_mod
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier1_mod months = 8 mode = replace }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_mil_ascend_ev } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_mil_ascend_ev value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.1 days = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_heg2_mil_tier
				var:oe_heg2_mil_tier >= 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_mil_tier value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_mil_ticks value = 0 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier1_mod
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier2_mod
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier3_mod
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_eclipse_cd } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_eclipse_cd years = 10 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.8 days = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: synchronize nav hegemon deepening tier (1..3) and eclipse check.
oe_heg2_sync_nav = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_nav_ticks }

		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_nav_ticks value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:oe_heg2_nav_ticks >= 40
					AND = {
						var:oe_heg2_nav_ticks >= 16

					}
				}
			}

			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier2_mod
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier3_mod months = 8 mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:oe_heg2_nav_ticks >= 20
					AND = {
						var:oe_heg2_nav_ticks >= 6
						oe_heg2_meets_nav_t2 = yes
					}
					has_advance = oe_heg2_adv_grand_hegemony
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_nav_tier value = 2 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier1_mod
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier3_mod
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier2_mod months = 8 mode = replace }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_nav_tier value = 1 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier2_mod
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier3_mod
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier1_mod months = 8 mode = replace }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_nav_ascend_ev } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_nav_ascend_ev value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.2 days = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_heg2_nav_tier
				var:oe_heg2_nav_tier >= 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_nav_tier value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_nav_ticks value = 0 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier1_mod
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier2_mod
			remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier3_mod
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_eclipse_cd } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_eclipse_cd years = 10 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.8 days = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
	}
}

# Country scope: synchronize multi-hegemon escalating diplomatic isolation, peak count (W4 oe_heg2_max_held), and tension.
oe_heg2_sync_isolation = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_heg2_held_count >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_max_held }
					AND = {
						has_variable = oe_heg2_max_held
						oe_heg2_held_count > var:oe_heg2_max_held
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_max_held value = oe_heg2_held_count }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_heg2_held_count >= 4 }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_1
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_2
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_3
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_4 months = 8 mode = replace }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists value = 1 }
		oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 12 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_tri_ev } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tri_ev value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.6 days = 7 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_heg2_held_count = 3 }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_1
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_2
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_4
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_3 months = 8 mode = replace }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists value = 1 }
		oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_tri_ev } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tri_ev value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.6 days = 7 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_heg2_held_count = 2 }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_1
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_3
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_4
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_2 months = 8 mode = replace }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists value = 1 }
		oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_dual_ev } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_dual_ev value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.5 days = 5 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_heg2_held_count = 1 }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_2
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_3
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_4
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_1 months = 8 mode = replace }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg } }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_1
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_2
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_3
		remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_4
	}
}

# Any scope. O(1) Great Power scan refreshing W3 handoff cache (polar_leader, polar_rival) + Slot 67 / Slot 65 synergy.
oe_heg2_refresh_polar_cache = {
	ordered_great_power = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			OR = {
				is_hegemon = yes
				has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg
			}
		}
		order_by = oe_heg2_polar_weight
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = oe_heg2_cand_leader
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_polar_leader value = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader }
		ordered_great_power = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { this = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader }
				NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader }
				NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader } }
			}
			order_by = oe_heg2_rival_weight
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_heg2_cand_rival
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_rival }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_polar_rival value = scope:oe_heg2_cand_rival }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_rival }
			remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_rival
		}
		# Read-only synergy with Slot 67 (oe_heg_ai_target) & Slot 65 (oe_ent_index):
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_active
				global_var:oe_heg_ai_active = 1
				has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target
				global_var:oe_heg_ai_target ?= scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
			}
			oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader = {
					has_variable = oe_ent_index
					var:oe_ent_index >= 60
				}
			}
			oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 2 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_leader }
			remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_leader
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_rival }
			remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_rival
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists }
				global_var:oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists ?= 0
			}
		}
		oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = -2 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Cooldown-gated diplomatic & flavor event dispatch during semi-annual ticks.
oe_heg2_dispatch_cycle_events = {
	# Secret Anti-Hegemon Diplomatic Communique (oe_heg2.7) to top rival GP when tension >= 40
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_rival
			exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
			has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension
			global_var:oe_heg2_tension >= 40
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev7_cd }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_ev7_cd years = 15 }
		scope:oe_heg2_cand_rival = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.7 days = 10 }
		}
	}
	# Continental vs Maritime Blockade clash (oe_heg2.9) when >= 1650 & tension >= 45
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1650
			exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
			has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension
			global_var:oe_heg2_tension >= 45
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev9_cd }
			scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader = {
				OR = {
					is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon
					is_hegemon_type = hegemony:economic_hegemon
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_ev9_cd years = 18 }
		scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.9 days = 14 }
		}
	}
	# Universal Court Language & Enlightenment Salons (oe_heg2.10) when >= 1620
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1620
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev10_cd }
			any_great_power = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:cultural_hegemon }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_ev10_cd years = 20 }
		random_great_power = {
			limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:cultural_hegemon }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.10 days = 18 }
		}
	}
	# Critical Tension Peak (>= 80): Eve of Great War Ultimatum (oe_heg2.11)
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
			oe_heg2_tension_critical = yes
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev11_cd }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_ev11_cd years = 15 }
		scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.11 days = 8 }
		}
	}
	# Hegemonic Restraint Accord (oe_heg2.12): hegemon may voluntarily cool tension >= 55
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader
			has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension
			global_var:oe_heg2_tension >= 55
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev12_cd }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_ev12_cd years = 15 }
		scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_heg2.12 days = 22 }
		}
	}
}

# Slot 85 main entry point (called by oe_mainline_lock.txt & oe_heg2_pulse.txt; deduplicated per month).
# O(1): short-circuits before 1540 and on 10 of 12 months; semi-annual scan touches only Great Powers (~8).
oe_heg2_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_heg2_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_init } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_init value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						current_year >= 1540
						OR = {
							current_month = 3
							current_month = 9
						}
					}
					global_var:oe_heg2_sim_active ?= 1
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_heg2_sim_active ?= 1 } }
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists value = 0 }
			}
			every_great_power = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					is_subject = no
				}
				oe_heg2_sync_mil = yes
				oe_heg2_sync_nav = yes
				oe_heg2_sync_eco = yes
				oe_heg2_sync_cul = yes
				oe_heg2_sync_isolation = yes
			}
			oe_heg2_refresh_polar_cache = yes
			oe_heg2_dispatch_cycle_events = yes
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Dev Panel Page 81 Clean Helpers (zero log commands; safe for player-command options)
# ==============================================================================

# Dev Helper 1: Simulate Anti-Hegemon Tension = 75 (readies W3 >= 65 threshold & CBs)
oe_heg2_dev_sim_tension_75 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_init value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension value = 75 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_sim_active value = 1 }
	save_scope_as = oe_heg2_cand_leader
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_polar_leader value = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader }
	set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_mil_tier value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_eco_tier value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_max_held value = 2 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier2_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_eco_tier2_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_3 years = 5 mode = replace }
	ordered_great_power = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { this = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader }
		}
		order_by = oe_heg2_rival_weight
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = oe_heg2_cand_rival
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_rival }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_polar_rival value = scope:oe_heg2_cand_rival }
	}
}

# Dev Helper 2: Simulate 4D Multi-Hegemon Apex State (enables all 4 Tier 3 mods, cabinet, interactions & apex decisions)
oe_heg2_dev_sim_multi_heg = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_init value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension value = 85 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_sim_active value = 1 }
	save_scope_as = oe_heg2_cand_leader
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_polar_leader value = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader }
	set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_mil_tier value = 3 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_nav_tier value = 3 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_eco_tier value = 3 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_cul_tier value = 3 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_max_held value = 4 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier3_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier3_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_eco_tier3_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_cul_tier3_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_4 years = 10 mode = replace }
	ordered_great_power = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { this = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_heg2_cand_leader }
		}
		order_by = oe_heg2_rival_weight
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = oe_heg2_cand_rival
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_cand_rival }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_polar_rival value = scope:oe_heg2_cand_rival }
	}
}

# Dev Helper 3: Open Read-Only Audit Dashboard (oe_heg2.90)
oe_heg2_dev_readout = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_heg2.90
}

# Dev Helper 4: Clean Reset of all Slot 85 simulation variables, modifiers & tension cache
oe_heg2_dev_reset = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_sim_active } remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_sim_active }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_leader } remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_leader }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_rival } remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_rival }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev7_cd } remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev7_cd }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev9_cd } remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev9_cd }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev10_cd } remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev10_cd }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev11_cd } remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev11_cd }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev12_cd } remove_global_variable = oe_heg2_ev12_cd }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg } remove_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_mil_tier } remove_variable = oe_heg2_mil_tier }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_nav_tier } remove_variable = oe_heg2_nav_tier }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_eco_tier } remove_variable = oe_heg2_eco_tier }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_cul_tier } remove_variable = oe_heg2_cul_tier }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_mil_ticks } remove_variable = oe_heg2_mil_ticks }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_nav_ticks } remove_variable = oe_heg2_nav_ticks }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_eco_ticks } remove_variable = oe_heg2_eco_ticks }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_cul_ticks } remove_variable = oe_heg2_cul_ticks }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_max_held } remove_variable = oe_heg2_max_held }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_apex_declared } remove_variable = oe_heg2_apex_declared }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_apex_mil_done } remove_variable = oe_heg2_apex_mil_done }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_apex_nav_done } remove_variable = oe_heg2_apex_nav_done }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_apex_eco_done } remove_variable = oe_heg2_apex_eco_done }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_apex_cul_done } remove_variable = oe_heg2_apex_cul_done }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_mil_ascend_ev } remove_variable = oe_heg2_mil_ascend_ev }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_nav_ascend_ev } remove_variable = oe_heg2_nav_ascend_ev }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_eco_ascend_ev } remove_variable = oe_heg2_eco_ascend_ev }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_cul_ascend_ev } remove_variable = oe_heg2_cul_ascend_ev }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_dual_ev } remove_variable = oe_heg2_dual_ev }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_tri_ev } remove_variable = oe_heg2_tri_ev }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_heg2_eclipse_cd } remove_variable = oe_heg2_eclipse_cd }
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier1_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier2_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_mil_tier3_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier1_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier2_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_nav_tier3_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_eco_tier1_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_eco_tier2_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_eco_tier3_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_cul_tier1_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_cul_tier2_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_cul_tier3_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_1
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_2
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_3
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_overlord_isolation_4
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_apex_mil_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_apex_nav_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_apex_eco_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_heg2_apex_cul_mod
}
